description: Track Google Workspace Marketplace apps, categories, search results and reviews. No login or API key required.

appIds.description: Numeric app IDs or full marketplace app URLs, e.g. 7081045131 or https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/lucidchart/7081045131.
appIds.title: App IDs or URLs (mode=appDetails or reviews)

categories.description: One or more marketplace categories or curated lists. All selected categories are unioned and deduplicated.
categories.title: Categories (mode=category)

developerFilter.description: Only keep apps whose developer name or website contains this text, e.g. "zoho" or "lucidchart.com".
developerFilter.title: Developer contains

includeCategoryMembership.description: Scan all 27 category listings to fill each app's categories list (top-100 listings only). Adds 27 requests.
includeCategoryMembership.title: Resolve category membership

includeDetails.description: Open each app page to add the exact OAuth scopes, sensitive-access flags and independent security-verification badge. Adds one request per app.
includeDetails.title: Include OAuth permissions and security badge

includeReviews.description: Also output the reviews of every matched app as separate rows (recordType workspace_review). Adds one app page request plus up to maxReviewsPerApp / 10 review-page requests per app.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

maxItems.description: Maximum app rows to return. Listings are fetched in slices until this many matching apps are found (or the marketplace is exhausted). In reviews mode this caps review rows instead.
maxItems.title: Max app records

maxReviewRating.description: Only include reviews with at most this star rating (1–5). Set 2 for complaints only.
maxReviewRating.title: Maximum review stars

maxReviewsPerApp.description: Stop after this many matching reviews per app.
maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app

minInstalls.description: Only keep apps with at least this many exact installs. Leave 0 for any.
minInstalls.title: Minimum installs

minRating.description: Only keep apps rated at least this (0–5). Leave 0 for any rating.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviewRating.description: Only include reviews with at least this star rating (1–5).
minReviewRating.title: Minimum review stars

minReviews.description: Only keep apps with at least this many ratings. Leave 0 for any.
minReviews.title: Minimum review count

mode.description: Pick a category/curated list, a keyword search, specific apps, or their reviews.
mode.title: What to scrape

pricing.description: Only keep apps with this pricing model. Apps that do not state pricing are excluded when a specific model is selected.
pricing.title: Pricing model

reviewsSince.description: Only include reviews posted on or after this date, e.g. 2026-01-01. Leave blank for no date limit.
reviewsSince.title: Reviews since

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search in the marketplace, e.g. "mail merge", "crm", "pdf". Each query is ranked separately and results are deduplicated.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search)

sortBy.description: Order of reviews when reviews are collected.
sortBy.title: Review order

worksWith.description: Only keep apps that integrate with this Google app. Applied to listings and app lookups.
worksWith.title: Works with

title: Google Workspace Marketplace Category Tracker Input
